stemMd: How many oxygen atoms are represented by three formula units of Al₂(SO₄)₃?
explanationMd: One sulfate group has four oxygen atoms; three sulfate groups give twelve per formula unit. Three formula units therefore contain 3 × 12 = 36 oxygen atoms. Apply the parentheses multiplier before the number of formula units.

distractorRationale.b: Twelve is the oxygen count in one formula unit.
distractorRationale.a: This counts sulfate groups rather than oxygen atoms.
distractorRationale.c: This may multiply by the aluminium subscript instead of the oxygen count.
distractorRationale.d: This omits one of the three sulfate groups per unit.
